title: [bmp] test_restart_bmp_docker fails on DUTs without BMP feature: "Unit bmp.service not found"
author: ediwibowo-msft
body:
### Description

`bmp/test_docker_restart.py::test_restart_bmp_docker` fails on testbeds where the BMP feature is not enabled/installed. The test unconditionally calls `asichost.restart_service("bmp")`, which runs `sudo systemctl start bmp`. On a DUT without the BMP service the command returns rc=5 with `Failed to start bmp.service: Unit bmp.service not found.`, failing the test instead of skipping.

Observed on testbed with a BMC DUT.

### Steps to reproduce

```
python3 -m pytest bmp/test_docker_restart.py \
    --inventory=../ansible/veos,../ansible/str4 --host-pattern=all \
    --testbed=<bmc_testbed> --testbed_file=../ansible/testbed.yaml \
    --topology bmc,any
```

### Actual result

```
tests.common.errors.RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module command failed, Ansible Results =>
failed = True
rc = 5
cmd = ['sudo', 'systemctl', 'start', 'bmp']
stderr = Failed to start bmp.service: Unit bmp.service not found.
```

Traceback:
```
File ".../tests/bmp/test_docker_restart.py", line 21, in test_restart_bmp_docker
    asichost.restart_service("bmp")
File ".../tests/common/devices/sonic_asic.py", line 249, in restart_service
    return self.sonichost.restart_service(service_name, docker_name)
File ".../tests/common/devices/sonic.py", line 2341, in restart_service
    self.command("sudo systemctl start {}".format(service_name))
```

### Expected result

The test should not hard-fail on DUTs/platforms where the BMP feature/service is not present. It should either:
- Skip (`pytest.skip`) when the BMP image/feature is unavailable (consistent with `BMPEnvironment` in `tests/common/helpers/bmp_utils.py`, which checks `docker images | grep -w sonic-bmp` and `docker ps | grep -w bmp`), or
- Enable the BMP feature first (`sudo config feature state bmp enabled`, as in `bmp/helper.py:enable_bmp_feature`) and only skip if BMP is not supported at all.

### Additional context

- Test file: `tests/bmp/test_docker_restart.py`
- Related helpers: `tests/bmp/helper.py` (`enable_bmp_feature`), `tests/common/helpers/bmp_utils.py` (`BMPEnvironment`)
- Other BMP tests (`test_bmp_configdb.py`, `test_bmp_statedb.py`) enable BMP tables but likewise assume the BMP container is present.

### Type of issue
- [x] Test case bug / test infrastructure improvement

linkedPullRequests.title: [bmc][bmp]: Skip test_restart_bmp_docker on bmc topology
linkedPullRequests.author: ediwibowo-msft
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR
Summary:
Fixes #27441

`bmp/test_docker_restart.py::test_restart_bmp_docker` calls `asichost.restart_service("bmp")`, which runs `sudo systemctl start bmp`. On `bmc` topology the BMP service is not present, so this fails with `Failed to start bmp.service: Unit bmp.service not found.` (rc=5) instead of being skipped.

This PR skips the test on `bmc` topology using the `conditional_mark` plugin (no in-code changes to the test).

### Type of change
- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [ ] 202511
- [x] 202608

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The test hard-fails on `bmc` topology testbeds (e.g. `str4-Nokia-7220-Th6p-1-bmc` on `vms77-bmc-7220-1`), producing false negatives because the BMP service is not present there.

#### How did you do it?
Added a `conditional_mark` entry in `tests/common/plugins/conditional_mark/tests_mark_conditions.yaml` that skips `bmp/test_docker_restart.py::test_restart_bmp_docker` when `topo_type in ['bmc']`. This keeps the skip policy in the central conditions file and leaves the test body unchanged.

#### How did you verify/test it?
- Verified the YAML parses and the new key resolves to the expected skip condition.
- On a `bmc` topology, the test is marked skipped; on other topologies it runs as before.

#### Any platform specific information?
Skips on `bmc` topology.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
N/A — existing test.

### Documentation
N/A
